assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced-proximity degradation converts binding into removal of the target protein, a genuinely new drug modality rather than a refinement of inhibition. Heterobifunctional PROTACs and the cereblon/VHL-recruiting chemistry have produced clinical-stage degraders. This meets my standard of a game-changer with real consequences.
assessment.attribution: Crews conceived and first demonstrated PROTACs and named them; Deshaies co-developed the early concept and the ubiquitin-ligase framework; Ciulli delivered the VHL ligand chemistry and the structural basis of ternary-complex cooperativity. Handa/Ito (thalidomide-cereblon), Gray and Sakamoto are strong claimants, so the three-person cut is hard.
assessment.maturity: Clinical validation is advancing (e.g. phase 3 degraders) but no approved PROTAC exists as far as I know, so timing is somewhat early; molecular glues versus PROTACs may be viewed as two partly separate discoveries.
uncertainties: Whether molecular-glue degraders (cereblon) should be recognised separately from PROTACs
Priority split between Crews, Deshaies and Ciulli versus Handa/Ito; I have not independently verified current clinical status

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editing chemically converts one base to another without double-strand breaks, an enzyme-engineering and nucleotide-chemistry achievement that created a new genome-editing class with therapeutic consequences, including in vivo clinical trials.
assessment.attribution: David R. Liu is the clear intellectual driver, with Komor and Gaudelli as lead trainee inventors of the cytosine and adenine editors. A prize to Liu alone is a clean configuration, since the 2020 prize already recognised CRISPR itself and the editing platform is largely his.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent adoption and early clinical data (e.g. patients treated), but long-term safety and efficacy evidence is still accruing; recognition is plausible but could be considered slightly premature versus prime editing maturing.
uncertainties: Overlap in credit with prime editing (same laureate, a separate entry)
Whether the committee views genome editing as sufficiently chemical after 2020
Long-term clinical outcomes unverified by me

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Discovery of a cryptic pocket enabling covalent inhibition of KRAS G12C turned a target long considered undruggable into a drug (sotorasib), and his analog-sensitive kinase chemical genetics earlier changed signalling research. Simple, elegant chemistry with big consequences.
assessment.attribution: A single laureate with unambiguous priority for the covalent KRAS G12C approach; no credit dispute that I am aware of, which fits a three-person limit trivially.
assessment.maturity: Approved drugs (sotorasib, adagrasib) and broad follow-on work confirm the concept; resistance and durability limits are clinical, not conceptual. Timing seems right.
uncertainties: Whether a single-person prize is fully fair given industry teams (Araxes, Amgen)
Details of drug-development credit not independently verified

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Pd-catalysed C-N coupling is a workhorse of medicinal and process chemistry, used daily at industrial scale, and extends the logic of the 2010 cross-coupling prize into a different bond class. Simple, general and enormously consequential.
assessment.attribution: Buchwald and Hartwig independently developed the general ligand-controlled catalysts after Migita/Kosugi's early tin-amine coupling; two laureates form a natural pair. Kosugi's precursor is a historical complication but of lesser generality.
assessment.maturity: Four decades of independent confirmation and industrial use; recognition is mature and arguably overdue, though overlap with 2010 may weigh against it.
uncertainties: Committee reluctance to reward a field adjacent to the 2010 prize
Credit to Migita/Kosugi precursors versus the ligand-development leaders

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Car-Parrinello molecular dynamics made first-principles dynamics of condensed phases and reactions routine, a foundational method of computational chemistry whose consequences span solvation, catalysis, materials and biomolecules. My own field values methods that connect quantitatively to experiment, and this one does so.
assessment.attribution: The 1985 paper is by exactly two authors, so attribution is unusually clean and a two-person prize is natural. Parrinello also appears in metadynamics and ML potentials, which complicates how the committee would frame his citation.
assessment.maturity: Four decades of independent use and extensive validation; it is mature and arguably long overdue, though later methods (DFT, ML potentials) have partly superseded it for some uses.
uncertainties: Risk of the committee preferring a broader Parrinello-centred computational prize
Relative standing versus ML potentials and DFT development

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the enabling delivery chemistry of siRNA therapeutics and mRNA vaccines, with enormous demonstrated global impact. The pKa-tuned ionizable lipid design is a real chemical insight, not just an engineering optimisation.
assessment.attribution: Cullis's group established ionizable-lipid LNP formulation, with Hope, Madden and MacLachlan central; Anderson and Langer contributed lipidomimetic libraries. Credit is distributed across many people and companies, so choosing three is difficult and contestable.
assessment.maturity: Clinically and commercially validated (patisiran, COVID-19 mRNA vaccines). The 2023 Medicine prize recognised the mRNA science but not the delivery chemistry, so timing is plausible.
uncertainties: Attribution among Cullis, Hope, Madden, MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer is unresolved
Patent and corporate priority disputes I cannot verify

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetic code expansion with orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs lets cells incorporate designed noncanonical amino acids into proteins, a conceptually new capability of protein chemistry with wide application in mechanism studies, therapeutics and synthetic biology.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the first orthogonal pair and in vivo incorporation; Chin extended the approach to eukaryotes, multiple codons and genome-level recoding. Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama are significant contributors, so a three-person cap forces hard choices.
assessment.maturity: Highly mature with many confirmations and growing applications, though many uses remain research tools; therapeutic payoff is still emerging.
uncertainties: Competing claims of Wang, Mehl and Yokoyama
Whether application consequences yet match the 'game-changer' standard

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The funnel-shaped energy landscape and principle of minimal frustration resolved Levinthal's paradox and gave quantitative theory that connects to experiment, and underlies later structure-prediction and folding-kinetics thinking. This is theory in the spirit I judge by.
assessment.attribution: Bryngelson and Wolynes introduced the landscape/spin-glass formulation; Onuchic developed funnel theory and simulations; Dill and Fersht contributed lattice-model and experimental mapping respectively, so credit is distributed and the three-laureate cut is debatable.
assessment.maturity: Concepts are widely accepted but the interpretation is conceptual rather than a single decisive discovery; after the 2024 prize on protein structure prediction and design, it may be judged either as complementary or as less urgent.
uncertainties: Contested attribution among Wolynes, Onuchic, Bryngelson, Dill and Fersht
Whether it is a distinct discovery or a framework already partly recognised via the 2024 prize
